 Detroit Red Wings vs Avalanche Credit: Ron Chenoy-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Red Wings vs. Avalanche Projected Lines, Injuries and How to Watch 
 The Detroit Red Wings have lost three out of the last four and are now on a tough road trip starting Saturday evening against the Colorado Avalanche. Laura Lambert | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Detroit Red Wings vs Avalanche Credit: Ron Chenoy-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Detroit Red Wings Colorado Avalanche Trying to break a losing streak is hard and it gets even harder when you are attempting to do it on the road. The Detroit Red Wings are starting a five-day road trip on Saturday against the Colorado Avalanche at Ball Arena in Denver.
--> Trying to break a losing streak is hard and it gets even harder when you are attempting to do it on the road. The Detroit Red Wings are starting a five-day road trip on Saturday against the Colorado Avalanche at Ball Arena in Denver.
 This will not be easy. Both teams are looking to break a two-game losing streak. Detroit comes in with a 7-7-3 record after losing to Tampa Bay and Vegas. Colorado sits at 9-6-2 after dropping its last two games as well.
--> This will not be easy. Both teams are looking to break a two-game losing streak. Detroit comes in with a 7-7-3 record after losing to Tampa Bay and Vegas. Colorado sits at 9-6-2 after dropping its last two games as well.
 The Red Wings have to get their offense rolling again, while the Avalanche have been struggling on defense. One positive note for Detroit is that their rookies have combined for 23 points in 17 games which leads the NHL in rookie scoring.
--> The Red Wings have to get their offense rolling again, while the Avalanche have been struggling on defense. One positive note for Detroit is that their rookies have combined for 23 points in 17 games which leads the NHL in rookie scoring.

 Red Wings vs. Avalanche Pregame Preview
--> Red Wings vs. Avalanche Pregame Preview
 The goaltending situation in Detroit has been uncertain several times this season so far, but Daniil Tarasov has continued to put up outstanding performances . 
--> The goaltending situation in Detroit has been uncertain several times this season so far, but Daniil Tarasov has continued to put up outstanding performances . 
 When asked again on Thursday evening against the Golden Knights, Tarasov stopped 32 of 34 shots. He did his part; the offense for the Red Wings did not.
--> When asked again on Thursday evening against the Golden Knights, Tarasov stopped 32 of 34 shots. He did his part; the offense for the Red Wings did not.
 Anton Johansson was the only player able to find the net and that didn’t happen until the third period. 
--> Anton Johansson was the only player able to find the net and that didn’t happen until the third period. 
 Tarasov has been absolutely dependable for this team through the early season. He has posted a 1.79 goals-against average and a .929 save percentage. 
--> Tarasov has been absolutely dependable for this team through the early season. He has posted a 1.79 goals-against average and a .929 save percentage. 
 Viktor Arvidsson is leading Detroit with eight goals.
--> Viktor Arvidsson is leading Detroit with eight goals.
 Colorado will present a difficult challenge for a team trying to discover its offense. The Avs lead the NHL with 53 five-on-five goals through 17 games. This will make Tarasov’s performance on Saturday very important.
--> Colorado will present a difficult challenge for a team trying to discover its offense. The Avs lead the NHL with 53 five-on-five goals through 17 games. This will make Tarasov’s performance on Saturday very important.
 Helping Detroit will be the fact that Colorado has been struggling on defense. The Red Wings will need to find ways to take advantage of that while also generating a lot of defensive pressure.
--> Helping Detroit will be the fact that Colorado has been struggling on defense. The Red Wings will need to find ways to take advantage of that while also generating a lot of defensive pressure.
 Saturday’s game will remind fans of the once heated rivaly between these two organizations, but that certainly won’t define this matchup. Each of these teams is just trying to find a way to break their losing streak, and, luckily for them, one team will walk away with a victory.
